prompt:
Build a physically causal closed-loop liquid-cooling system for a data center. The plant must contain a server heat source, a chilled-water loop, a separate condenser-water loop, a real water-to-water heat exchanger, a chiller path between the loops, and a cooling tower coupled to ambient temperature and relative humidity. Separate physical pumps must circulate the two water loops. The chiller must regulate its evaporator outlet to about 18 degC, the chilled-water pump must respond to server outlet temperature to keep it near its intended operating range around 28 degC, and the condenser-water pump must respond to the condenser-to-tower temperature difference around 6 degC. Internal controller form and chiller implementation are not prescribed.

Read ServerLoadScale, AmbientTemperatureOffset_C, RelativeHumidityScale, ChilledWaterPumpCapacityScale, and ChillerCapacityScale from the MATLAB base workspace. Their nominal values are 1, 0 degC, 1, 1, and 1, with supported ranges 0.75--1.25, -3--5 degC, 0.85--1.15, 0.85--1, and 0.85--1.05. Apply the load and weather inputs to the physical server and cooling-tower boundaries, and apply capacity scales to the corresponding real pump and chiller actuation paths.

Across the declared range, keep temperatures, liquid flows, heat transfers, evaporation, and equipment powers finite and physically consistent. The loops must follow variable server load and weather, remain within their thermal capacity, and recover after profile changes. Do not prescribe temperature or power traces, hard-code a coefficient of performance, or replace the two water loops with a single ideal sink.

Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named thermal_state, flow_control_state, heat_power_state, and environment_state. thermal_state has 5 channels in this order: evaporator outlet, server outlet, heat-exchanger outlet, condenser outlet, and cooling-tower outlet temperature, all in degC. flow_control_state has 5 channels [chilled-water and condenser-water mass flow (kg/s),chilled-pump command,condenser-pump command,chiller command]. heat_power_state has 9 channels [server heat,heat-exchanger transfer,evaporator heat,cooling-tower heat,compressor power,condenser-pump power,chilled-pump power,tower-fan power,total auxiliary power], all in W. environment_state has 3 channels [ambient temperature (degC),relative humidity,tower evaporation (kg/s)]. Save the completed model as cand_XTHERM08.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XTHERM08.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
